NeMo Guardrails

Guardrail Types

Apply input, retrieval, dialog, execution, and output rails to protect LLM applications.

The NeMo Guardrails library applies guardrails at multiple stages of the LLM interaction. Input rails apply guardrails before the LLM is called by validating and sanitizing user inputs. Retrieval rails filter and validate retrieved knowledge to ensure only trusted context is provided to the LLM. Dialog rails steer and constrain the multi-turn conversation. Execution rails control and validate tool and function calls, their arguments, and results. Output rails evaluate and post-process model responses before they reach users.

Input and Output rails are the most common.
